_doc: Checkpoint-resume finalisation for W3 after the first pilot was budget-capped mid-write. Proves acceptance criterion 8 (restart resumes checkpoint) and the end-to-end RESULT.json path on a real worker. Read-only, non-browser.

items.directive:
RESUME FROM CHECKPOINT. READ-ONLY, no browser, no production, no mutation.

A previous run of you was cut off by budget after completing the audit. Your own prior work is in your run directory: CHECKPOINT.json and EVIDENCE/regression-integrity.md. Read both FIRST. Do NOT redo the audit from scratch.

Your only remaining job: (1) verify EVIDENCE/regression-integrity.md is complete against CHECKPOINT.json steps_remaining; (2) if any step is genuinely unfinished, finish ONLY that step and append to the evidence file; (3) write the final RESULT.json with verdict PASS (audit complete, evidence-backed) and an evidence block that cites the specific findings - closure chain broken for BUG-001/003/006/ANON-INVESTOR-RLS-HELPER, 13 orphan files, 2 assertion-less regressions. Cite counts from your own evidence file. Do not invent new findings. Finish quickly.
